messages:
carmen: Opening a 45m change window to run a staged rollout for py/ts SDKs. Plan: publish `staged-3743210000` dist-tag, route 8% internal, smoke + compatibility checks. @sam please publish, @maria_s prep a short note mentioning the sync-client deprecation.

sam: Artifacts built. Publishing now: `npm publish --tag staged-3743210000` and uploading wheel to testpypi.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: publish job started -> internal npm + pypi-staging. CI logs: https://ci.redwood.example/3743210000/logs

maria_s: Draft note created: "Staged rollout for compatibility testing. No GA changes. Reminder: legacy sync client deprecation in upcoming release." Draft: https://docs.redwood.example/drafts/staged-3743210000

jun: Enabling feature flag for 8% cohort. Monitors: p50/p99 latency, error-rate, artifact-verify. Abort on error-rate >1% or verify failures >0.5%.

ops: Alert: artifact-verify failures at 0.9% in eu-west-1, older clients failing signature header check.

carmen: Pausing cohort. Sam, can you remove dist-tag and unpublish staging artifact while we triage? Also prepare a pin PR for internal configs.

sam: Running rollback steps: `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk staged-3743210000` and deleting staging wheel where allowed. Pin PR: https://github.com/redwood/internal-configs/pull/709 (pins to 1.3.4-stable).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback complete. Dist-tag removed; traffic reverted to stable. Rollback CI: https://ci.redwood.example/3743210000/rollback status: success.

maria_s: Updating release notes: "Staged rollout paused due to artifact verification regressions for older clients; stable unchanged. Investigation underway." Will add migration steps and call out deprecation.

carmen: Action items: 1) revert signing change on canary pipeline, 2) add backward-compatible key discovery and client fallback, 3) add e2e for older-client verification, 4) re-run staged rollout Wed 09:00 UTC. Assigning owners.

sam: Thanks all, opening follow-up ticket with traces and CI artifacts.

carmen: Closing window, will share internal advisory after the ticket is triaged. :thumbsup:
